services.name: Sunset Park Campground
services.desc: Welcome to port Clements, a vibrant community where neighbours become family and traditions thrive. Explore our website to discover the heart of our village. Located at the far (south) end of Sunset Park, near the bird tower and the Yakoun River Estuary, the Village owns and operates its municipal campground year-round. While the peak season is mid-May to mid-October, there are daring campers who come in the off-season and brave the winter storms. The campground has ten (10) cozy camping spots (six for RVs, and four for tenting) and a large public gazebo for picnicking. Nestled in-between the trees, mossy and with an unkempt beauty, this campground is for campers looking to embrace nature
